items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Terminology 16:1
items.html: (To the question) What is the general BAN? The lights and vessels that already served in the Nekudim, and after their breaking and nullification came and received correction in Atzilut by the lights and vessels that came out in Atzilut, called MAH, are called the general BAN. And the lights that came out in Atzilut are called the general MAH. See above, Answer 14. (Item 158).
